The one lapse is a single call site using two options that Kit 3 deleted, which also silently reverts to scroll-reset behavior there.

app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.server.js:150-170 — load returns a shaped view model (labels, formatted height/weight, table rows), so components never see raw API JSON
app/src/routes/+page.server.js:1-4 and app/src/routes/types/+page.server.js:1-5 — loads are thin delegations; no copy-pasted framework boilerplate

no tsconfig/svelte-check anywhere and 0 typeLines — boundaries are untyped, so data-shape or framework drift won't be caught statically
app/src/lib/components/MoveTable.svelte:28 — `untrack` in component init is a no-op (init isn't a reactive context); harmless but shows noise in the state pattern
churn_resistance.rationale: Data access is centralized behind one module, views consume view models, and config lives in exactly one place — framework or API changes would touch few files. The deductions are minor: duplicated flavor-text/missing-value helpers, zero type checking at the API boundary, and `process.env` instead of the framework env module.

findings.issue: `goto(url, { noScroll: true, keepFocus: true, replace: true })` uses options that SvelteKit 3 removed; `noScroll`/`keepFocus` were replaced by `reset: false` (Kit 3 breaking change, PR #16558). The dead options are silently ignored, so changing the game select resets scroll/focus.

`process.env.API_BASE_URL` reads the environment directly, bypassing Kit 3's env system (`src/env.js` with `defineEnvVars` + `$app/env/private`), which replaces the already-deprecated `$env/*` modules; this also hard-couples the app to Node-style env access.
findings.suggestion: Declare `API_BASE_URL` with `defineEnvVars` in `src/env.js` and import it from `$app/env/private` (with the localhost default as the schema fallback).

findings.issue: The 'latest English flavor text' selection and whitespace collapsing is re-implemented inline here and in moves/[name]/+page.server.js:24-27 although `latestEnglishFlavorText` already exists in lib/server/pokeapi.js:53-57; `isMissing` is likewise duplicated in three modules.
findings.suggestion: Export and reuse the shared helpers from `#lib` so a spec change to text handling touches one place.

findings.issue: `idFromUrl` hand-parses resource URLs with a regex instead of using the URL platform API.
findings.suggestion: Parse with `new URL(url).pathname` (then match the trailing id), which is robust to URL variations.

findings.issue: Outbound API fetch has no timeout or AbortController, so a hung upstream request stalls page loads indefinitely.
findings.suggestion: Add an AbortSignal.timeout(...) to the fetch for graceful failure.

findings.issue: `$state(untrack(() => ...))` wraps a non-reactive initialization in `untrack`, which has no effect outside deriveds/effects and obscures intent.
The afterNavigate hook filters on `navigation.type === 'popstate'`; Kit 3 now also fires navigation hooks for shallow navigations and provides an explicit `navigation.shallow` flag for filtering.
findings.suggestion: Filter with the documented `shallow` property so the hook stays correct if navigation types change.

findings.issue: The project is plain JS with a single JSDoc annotation and no `svelte-check`/tsconfig, so the API boundary (the highest-churn surface) is untyped.
findings.suggestion: Add JSDoc types for the PokeAPI shapes (or TS at the pokeapi module boundary) and wire `svelte-check` into CI.

summary: This is a genuinely current-generation SvelteKit 3 app: vite-plugin config, `#lib` subpath imports, runes, `$app/state`, string-form `error`, and the brand-new shallow-routing `goto` used appropriately. The single real lapse is one call site still passing Kit 3's removed `noScroll`/`keepFocus` options, plus `process.env` where the framework's new env system is the idiom. With zero runtime dependencies and all data access behind one server-only module, it should age well and require little churn on future upgrades.

apis.api: goto with { shallow, replace, reset, state }

apis.replacement: goto(url, { reset: false, replace: true }) — removed in SvelteKit 3 (svelte.dev/e/kit/goto_options_removed)
unnecessary here — component init is not a reactive context
defineEnvVars in src/env.js + $app/env/private (Kit 3 env system; $env/* modules deprecated in Kit 3)
